subsetPolicyRationale: `s.stdio.stl@ascii` is this plugin's own self-contained ASCII STL mesh file — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (set-snapshot, set-solid-name, insert-triangle, remove-triangle, set-triangle-normal, set-triangle-vertices, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
